Title: Ritual of the Bitter Rose Q:s

Messages.Author: AL
Messages.Body:
As RotBR has reworded in the CE, I have a question about it.

Theo Bell (for example) hits, say, Kite (in full blood) for 3, Disarms
and Decapitates him. Theo then plays Taste of Vitae and RotBR.

Question: Does Theo gain now 3 blood from Taste AND 4 blood for RotBR?

(I assume that RotBR was reworded to please old players with loads of
nearly-useless Rituals, right?)

-Antero
